newsitem.title: FRANCE: Thomson-CSF consortium set for Eurocopter order.
newsitem.headline: Thomson-CSF consortium set for Eurocopter order.

text.p: Franco-German helicopter maker Eurocopter has signed letters of intent to buy electronic warfare gear for its NH90 military helicopter from a consortium of Germany's Daimler-Benz Aerospace (DASA), Italy's Elettronica and France's Thomson-CSF, the consortium disclosed on Thursday.

A spokeswoman for the French defence electronics group, Thomson-CSF, said the contracts, if finalised, would be worth eight to nine billion francs over 15 to 20 years and that a third of that would be earmarked for Thomson-CSF.

The consortium said in a statement that the letters of intent were for 900 electronic warfare systems (EWS) and 180 electronic support measurement (ESM) systems for the NH90, being built by a consortium of Germany, France, Italy and the Netherlands.
Eurocopter is 70-percent held by Aerospatiale and 30 percent by Daimler-Benz Aerospace.
Thomson-CSF owns a third of the capital of Italian electronic and defence systems firm Elettronica SpA, sharing control with Finmeccanica SpA.
